Wrote the screening output and re-checked each cited line.

- **Output:** `/home/mara/cwe-bench/pipelines/stacking/out/screener-ds-rescreen/17861.json`
- **Trust decision:** login is decided in `core/user/service.go:28` (`Authenticate`) and the fix adds a per-user "code already used" compare-and-set (`database/user/repository.go` via `core/user/service.go`), but at pinned `91976f0` no TOTP verification exists at all — the feature is added by fix commit `1cbfae0` (migrations stop at 026), so the pin sits before the feature.
- **pattern_fit:** `A+B` (login + activation entry points, converter/schema layer, and an untouched admin `Save` route that clears the history) — valid only if re-pinned at the parent of `8d35e1e`; as pinned it is `none`.
- **Strongest lever:** the save/reload boundary — the used-code list must survive the `database/user` converter plus every generic `repository.Save`, and `core/user/service.go:146-154` (admin PUT with password) silently drops it, dismissible as "user management, not login replay".
- **Biggest red flag:** not on the fixed list — the pinned commit contains no TOTP at all, so the task as pinned would be a full feature build, not a ~45-minute fix; `O1`/`O2`/`O8` are therefore derived from the fix diff and flagged `unverified`.
